Hand-written shapes, never produced by running herdr. Each is what a script parsed before the
backend seam, taken from the scripts and their tests:
  agent-list*.json       roster.py _agents/format_roster and tests/test_roster.py; agent_session from
                         compaction_reprime.py _session_file and tests/test_compaction_reprime.py
  agent-get*.json        mailbox.py _supervisor_pane, closeout_check.py read_agent (tests/test_mailbox.py stub)
  pane-get.json          closeout_check.py read_pane
  process-info*.json     roster.py _launch_args, closeout_check.py read_processes and tests/test_closeout_check.py
  agent-wait*.json       waker.py wait_status and tests/test_waker.py
  error-*                waker.py _error_code (stderr error.code), mailbox.py/closeout_check.py (error as a plain string,
                         plain-text agent_blocked)
  agent-read.txt         waker.py read_tail (plain pane text on stdout)
